title: Port O Call Marina
specs: View dolphins, herons, egrets, osprey, turtles, bald eagles and other wildlife
Cruise to Keewaydin Island known for white sand, clear water, and shelling
Renters must be 26 years old and have positive ID and Visa or Mastercard at rental
If born on or after 1/1/1988, must have Florida Boaters Safety Card
Kids 6 years and younger must always wear a life vest
Deck boat seats 8 passengers; Tritoon seats 12 passengers
Charter boats vary in capacity from 6 to 19 passengers depending on boat

blurb: Guests can rent boats to explore Naples, Marco Island, and the Ten Thousand Islands, viewing wildlife and visiting local islands and waterfront restaurants. The marina offers a fleet of inspected rental boats with safety gear and provides safety briefings. Charter fishing trips are available year-round with various boats and captains specializing in offshore and inshore fishing.
extraNote: Rates subject to change; holiday rates may apply; plus 6% sales tax, fuel, and optional insurance · Boats are not permitted in the Gulf of Mexico · White building with blue roof at the bottom of the parking lot at 550 Port O Call Way, Naples, FL 34102
